Sobre nós:

A Asksuite foi eleita por 7 anos consecutivos a melhor plataforma de chatbot do mundo para o ramo de hospitalidade/turismo. Nossa IA atende 24/7 através de mensagens de forma instantânea, multilíngue e em vários canais de atendimento. Nossa plataforma omnichannel centraliza o atendimento humano de todos os canais de um hotel em uma única tela!
Temos clientes em mais de 80 países, fomos eleitos a 7 ª melhor empresa para trabalhar em SC pela Great Place to Work e a 1ª do mundo pela Hotel Tech Awards no segmento de tecnologia para o turismo. Nosso time possui mais de 100 talentos em mais de 7 países e estamos buscando uma pessoa com vontade de aprender e crescer junto com a gente.

O que é esperado desse cargo?

  • Liderança Técnica e Arquitetura: Projetar, direcionar e tomar decisões sobre a arquitetura (front-end e back-end) dos nossos sistemas, garantindo escalabilidade, performance, segurança e manutenção.

  • Mentoria e Desenvolvimento de Pessoas: Orientar, mentorar e dar feedbacks técnicos para os desenvolvedores da equipe, incentivando o crescimento contínuo e a disseminação de conhecimento.

  • Mão na Massa: Escrever código de alta qualidade, desenvolver features complexas, realizar testes automatizados e participar ativamente de code reviews.

  • Qualidade e Padrões: Definir e promover boas práticas de desenvolvimento para manter a qualidade das entregas do time.

  • Facilitação e Resolução de Bloqueios: Atuar na identificação e remoção de impedimentos técnicos, auxiliando o time na resolução de problemas complexos de engenharia.

  • Ponte com Negócio e Produto: Trabalhar lado a lado com os times de Produto e Design para traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos técnicos claros e estimativas realistas.

  • Evolução de Processos: Sugerir e implementar melhorias nos processos do ciclo de vida de desenvolvimento de software e metodologias ágeis.

Você vai se dar muito bem se:

  • Tiver sólida experiência prática como Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack e vivência com liderança técnica de times de software.

  • Tiver visão macro de arquitetura de software, padrão de projetos (design patterns) e sistemas SaaS distribuídos de alta disponibilidade.

  • For um(a) problem solver excepcional, com facilidade para decompor problemas complexos e propor soluções simples e eficientes.

  • Tiver excelente comunicação e habilidade para negociar prazos, prioridades e soluções com diferentes stakeholders.

  • For movido(a) a aprendizado contínuo, autodidata e proativo(a) para explorar novas tecnologias, metodologias e ferramentas.

  • Tiver paixão por desenvolver pessoas e construir uma cultura técnica forte, colaborativa e focada em resultados.

  • For apaixonado por crescimento e queira se desenvolver. Aqui as pessoas crescem junto com a empresa (e vice-versa);

  • Superior completo ou em andamento;

  • Experiência de pelo menos 4 anos em Node.Js;

  • Experiência como Líder Técnico;

  • Inglês básico - para codificação;

  • Disponibilidade para atuar 40h semanais.

Vai ser legal se você tiver, mas não é obrigatório:

  • Experiência com chatbots e/ou startups;

  • Experiência com as tecnologias:

    • Angular 2+;

    • Java (Ex.: Play Framework/Spring);

    • NestJS

    • Banco de dados relacional (Ex.: PostgreSQL);

    • Utilização de cloud (Ex.: AWS).

  • Experiência com testes automatizados.

Por que as pessoas amam fazer parte da Asksuite:

Nosso jeito de ser:

  • Somos uma empresa nova e em crescimento constante;

We’re a global, midsize CRO that pushes boundaries, innovates and invents because the path to a cure for the world’s most persistent diseases is not paved by those who play it safe. It is built by those who take pioneering, creative approaches and implement them with quality and excellence.

Our mission is to work with passion and purpose every day to improve lives and we are looking for others who value this same pursuit.

Why Worldwide

We believe everyone plays an important role in making a world of difference for patients and their caregivers. From our hands-on, accessible leaders, to our cohesive and supportive teams, we are committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed. We prioritize cultivating a diverse and inclusive environment that continues to promote collaboration and creativity. We are proud to be a workplace where people thrive by being themselves and are inspired to do their best work every day. Join us!

What the Contract Manager does at Worldwide

The Contract Manager is responsible for the overall management of activities involved in the development/preparation and revision of the company’s contracts/change orders with its sponsors.

The Contract Manager is responsible for the overall management of activities involved in the development/preparation and revision of the company’s contracts/change orders with its sponsors.

  • Collaborate with Business Development, Therapeutic Leaders, Operations, Finance and Legal departments to draft and finalize contracts/change orders and contract termination documents with sponsors.

  • Ability to work with minimal supervision with confidence.
  • Strong planning, strategizing, managing, monitoring, scheduling, and analytical skills.
  • Effective negotiation skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills in a fast-paced, deadline oriented, and changing environment.
  • Strong Excel skills; ability to manipulate and modify budget toll and client bid grids as required.
  • Effective stakeholder management with cross functional teams for process improvement and/or change initiatives.

Your experience

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.
  • Two to three years of direct experience with CRO or pharmaceutical data; sourcing, integration, analysis, and reporting.

That’s why we’re hiring a Head of Engineering.

Over the next two years, our goal is to significantly increase engineering capacity while improving predictability, reliability, and ownership. This role is central to making that happen.

This role exists because we’ve outgrown a purely founder‑driven engineering setup.

As Head of Engineering, your job is to turn a strong group of engineers into a scalable engineering organization. You sit between the Head of Technology (founder team) and the engineering teams and your goal is to build the structures, leadership layers, and delivery discipline required to support continued growth. This is a leadership role, but not a purely administrative one: you should still be able to contribute and understand technical context, help the team make sound decisions, challenge assumptions, and guide complex topics when needed.

  • Strong communication skills across technical and non‑technical stakeholders.

  • Good understanding of security fundamentals and secure software delivery.

Min. English C1

jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

‎

Position Summary
The Chief of Staff serves as a trusted strategic advisor and operational partner to the Chief Executive Officer, helping maximize executive effectiveness while accelerating execution of Mosaic Health’s highest-priority strategic initiatives.

This is a highly visible leadership role responsible for driving enterprise coordination, executive operating cadence, strategic execution, transformation initiatives, and executive communications across the organization. Acting as an extension of executive leadership, the Chief of Staff ensures priorities are translated into action, cross-functional teams remain aligned, and critical initiatives are executed with discipline and urgency.

The successful candidate will thrive in a fast-paced, private equity-backed environment and possess the judgment, business acumen, and influence required to work effectively across executive leadership, Board members, business unit leaders, and external stakeholders. This role requires someone who is equally comfortable shaping strategy, solving complex operational challenges, and driving flawless execution.

‎

How will you make an impact & Requirements

‎

What You’ll Do

Executive Office Leadership

  • Serve as a trusted advisor and operational extension of the CEO, ensuring executive focus remains on the organization’s highest-value priorities.
  • Manage executive priorities by coordinating decisions, tracking commitments, and ensuring timely execution of follow-up actions.
  • Anticipate leadership needs and proactively resolve issues before they require executive intervention.
  • Prepare the CEO for Board meetings, sponsor interactions, customer meetings, investor discussions, and other strategic engagements.
  • Continuously improve executive workflows by identifying opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and technology to increase productivity.

Executive Leadership Team Effectiveness

  • Own and continuously improve the Executive Leadership Team’s operating cadence.
  • Develop executive meeting agendas, pre-read materials, action logs, decision trackers, and governance processes.
  • Ensure accountability for enterprise commitments through disciplined follow-up and progress tracking.
  • Connect priorities across business units and corporate functions to identify risks, dependencies, and opportunities.
  • Foster collaboration across the executive team while promoting transparency, alignment, and shared accountability.

Strategy Execution & Enterprise Initiatives

  • Translate executive priorities into actionable workplans with defined milestones, owners, timelines, and measurable outcomes.
  • Lead cross-functional strategic initiatives that span multiple business units or lack a natural organizational owner.
  • Partner with senior leaders to remove execution barriers and accelerate enterprise priorities.
  • Develop executive dashboards and progress reports that provide visibility into strategic initiatives and organizational performance.
  • Support annual strategic planning and enterprise prioritization activities.

Enterprise Transformation

  • Coordinate enterprise transformation initiatives in partnership with executive leadership.
  • Maintain executive project plans, governance documentation, milestone tracking, dependency management, and decision logs.
  • Support organizational redesign, business integration, and enterprise change management initiatives.
  • Ensure transformation efforts remain aligned with Mosaic Health’s strategic objectives and value creation plan.

Executive Communications & Board Support

  • Develop polished executive presentations, Board materials, sponsor updates, and strategic communications.
  • Improve the quality, clarity, and effectiveness of executive messaging across internal and external audiences.
  • Coordinate responses to Board members, investors, and private equity sponsors.
  • Ensure executives are equipped with high-quality materials that enable informed decision-making and effective stakeholder engagement.

Organizational Leadership

  • Build trusted relationships with executives, business leaders, and functional teams across Mosaic Health.
  • Influence without formal authority through credibility, collaboration, and exceptional follow-through.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
  • Serve as a connector across the organization, helping leaders navigate complex issues and align around shared priorities.

What You’ll Bring

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Finance, Economics, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • MBA or other advanced degree preferred.
  • Eight or more years of experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, business operations, private equity, corporate development, investment banking, healthcare operations, or a Chief of Staff role supporting senior executives.
  • Experience working directly with a CEO or executive leadership team in a complex, high-growth organization.
  • Demonstrated success leading enterprise-wide, cross-functional strategic initiatives.
  • Exceptional analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, including executive-level presentation development.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple high-priority initiatives simultaneously while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially PowerPoint and Excel.
  • Experience leveraging AI tools and automation to improve business processes and executive productivity.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience within healthcare services, value-based care, managed care, provider organizations, or healthcare technology.
  • Experience working in a private equity-backed organization.
  • Familiarity with Board governance, investor communications, and sponsor reporting.
  • Experience supporting mergers, acquisitions, organizational integration, or enterprise transformation initiatives.

Leadership Competencies

The ideal candidate will demonstrate:

  • Exceptional integrity, discretion, and sound judgment.
  • Strong enterprise and commercial acumen.
  • Executive presence and emotional intelligence.
  • Ability to influence senior leaders without formal authority.
  • Outstanding organizational discipline and follow-through.
  • Strategic thinking combined with operational execution.
  • Ability to synthesize complex information into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Resourcefulness, adaptability, and resilience in a fast-moving environment.
  • High humility, low ego, and a collaborative leadership style.
  • A continuous improvement mindset with a passion for simplifying complexity.

Success in the Role

Within the first 12 months, the successful Chief of Staff will:

  • Significantly increase executive leadership effectiveness through disciplined operating cadence and organizational alignment.
  • Improve CEO leverage by assuming responsibility for high-impact strategic and operational work.
  • Deliver Board materials, executive presentations, and strategic communications that consistently require minimal executive revision.
  • Successfully coordinate enterprise strategic initiatives from planning through execution.
  • Strengthen accountability across executive workstreams through transparent governance and follow-through.
  • Improve cross-functional collaboration and visibility into enterprise priorities.
  • Implement AI-enabled workflows that enhance executive productivity and organizational efficiency.
  • Become a trusted advisor to executive leadership, Board members, and private equity sponsors through thoughtful judgment, credibility, and flawless execution.

Mosaic Health is committed to building an inclusive workplace where talented individuals from diverse backgrounds can thrive. We believe better care begins with empowered people, collaborative teams, and leaders who are passionate about improving the health of the communities we serve.

If you’re energized by solving complex problems, influencing enterprise-wide strategy, and helping shape the future of healthcare delivery, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.excerpt: A Career at HARMAN As a technology leader that is rapidly on the move, HARMAN is filled with people who are focused on making life better.
jobs.description:
A Career at HARMAN


As a technology leader that is rapidly on the move, HARMAN is filled with people who are focused on making life better. Innovation, inclusivity and teamwork are a part of our DNA. When you add that to the challenges we take on and solve together, you’ll discover that at HARMAN you can grow, make a difference and be proud of the work you do every day.

About the role

HARMAN's Software Experiences Business Unit (SEBU) builds software products that connect people to music

In this role you will build and lead the communities around our new consumer products. You will be the voice of the product in the spaces where our users gather, and the voice of the community inside the company. This means seeding and growing our founding communities, setting the tone and culture, moderating and guiding conversations, running programs and events that keep users engaged, and turning early users into advocates who bring others in.

You will own our owned community channels day to day, partner closely with the growth, product, and creative teams, and help shape the product and the community experience based on what you hear directly from users.

Your Team

This is an individual contributor role reporting directly to the Director, Product Strategy within the Software Experiences Business Unit, and works cross-functionally with product management, growth, marketing, design, and engineering, as well as external agencies and partners. The role may grow to include direct reports as the community scales.

What You Will Do

  • Set the tone, voice, and culture for our product communities, and be the person users recognize and trust in those spaces.
  • Seed and grow our founding communities on the platforms where our target users already gather (Discord, Reddit, and social channels), building presence and trust before scale.
  • Engage users daily: welcome new arrivals, spark and guide conversations, answer questions, and keep the community active and healthy.
  • Moderate discussions and enforce community guidelines fairly and consistently, evolving those guidelines as the community grows.
  • Plan and run programs, rituals, and events (challenges, AMAs, listening sessions) that give users reasons to keep coming back.
  • Identify, recruit, and nurture founding users, super-users, and tastemakers, and design recognition that turns them into advocates.
  • Create and program community-facing content and prompts that drive participation, and maintain a content and events calendar.
  • Be the voice of the community inside the company: capture sentiment and feedback, surface it to product, design, and growth, and advocate for users.
  • Partner with the growth and product teams on invite, sharing, and social-proof mechanics, bringing community insight into product decisions.
  • Track and report on community health and engagement, and adjust programs and outreach based on what the data shows.

What You Need

  • 3+ years of experience in community management, social media, or a closely related role, ideally for a consumer app, social product, or fan-driven brand.
  • A track record of building and growing an online community from an early stage, not only maintaining an established one.
  • Hands-on fluency with the platforms where communities live, especially Discord and Reddit, as well as TikTok, Instagram, and other social channels.
  • Exceptional written communication skills and an instinct for tone, able to move fluently between the brand voice and the culture of a given community.
  • Strong moderation judgment: able to keep a space welcoming and safe, de-escalate conflict, and enforce guidelines consistently.
  • Comfort planning and running community programs and events, and coordinating content calendars across channels.
  • A data-informed approach to community, comfortable defining and tracking engagement and health metrics and acting on what they show.
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment with shifting priorities.
  • Empathy and emotional intelligence, with a genuine interest in understanding and serving community members.
  • A genuine passion for music and music discovery, and an understanding of the culture around it.

What is Nice to Have

  • Experience launching or seeding a community for a new product ahead of a public launch.
  • Familiarity with the music or audio industry, including streaming platforms, artists, and fan communities.
  • Experience working with influencers, creators, or tastemakers as part of community or growth programs.
  • Familiarity with community and social management tooling and analytics (for example Discord bots and moderation tools, Discourse, social listening, and analytics dashboards).
  • Fluency with AI tools and a habit of using them to work faster and better — drafting and iterating on community content, summarizing member sentiment and feedback, and streamlining day-to-day workflows.
  • Experience working within a large global organization where a smaller, entrepreneurial business unit operates alongside established divisions.

What Makes You Eligible

  • Be willing to travel up to 25%, domestic and international travel.
  • Due to the nature of global infrastructure, you understand that flexibility in working hours is required.
  • This role is eligible to work remotely full-time with occasional trips into any HARMAN USA office (this could be on 24-hour notice)
  • Successfully complete a background investigation and drug screen as a condition of employment, post offer.

What We Offer

  • Inclusive and diverse work environment that fosters and encourages career development opportunities.
  • Flexible work schedule with a culture encouraging work life integration.
  • On-site opportunities to focus on personal well-being and development provided by our Wellness Committee, Volunteer Committee and Harman Women’s Network.
  • Professional development opportunities through HARMAN University’s business and leadership academies and extensive course catalog.
  • Opportunity to collaborate with talented teams across the world.
  • Access to employee discounts on world class HARMAN products

jobs.excerpt: About Vantage Data CentersVantage Data Centers powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises.
jobs.description:
About Vantage Data Centers

Vantage Data Centers powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

Procurement Department

The Procurement team is responsible for securing the equipment Vantage’s data centers require to function. The team leads these efforts from conception through commissioning, working with Sales, Operations, New Site Development, and Engineering along the way. Procurement also works closely with vendor partners to come up with a vertically integrated design, and we manage these partners to deliver the projects on schedule and budget. Vantage is unique in that our technical staff is given the responsibility and authority to directly drive the process. Our internal team can align long-term operational sustainability with value engineering and cost metrics to deliver products aligned with corporate goals. This approach empowers each member of the team to drive high- impact decisions and even more impactful results.

Position Overview

This role can be remote or based in any of our US locations: Denver, CO; Phoenix, AZ; Santa Clara, CA; or Ashburn, VA.

Lead the execution of global procurement operations and supplier management programs in support of strategies established by Procurement leadership. This role partners with and supports the Chief Procurement Officer in the execution of global procurement initiatives, working closely with Data Center Operations, Regional COOs, and site operating teams to enable reliable, secure, and cost-efficient operations through supplier frameworks, service agreements, and performance governance.

The Vice President manages and enhances global frameworks for maintenance, service delivery, security, spares, and asset lifecycle management, ensuring that external providers and internal supply chain capabilities consistently meet operational uptime, compliance, and customer SLA requirements. This is a supporting function, accountable for procurement operations performance, supplier governance, commercial structure, and lifecycle optimization, not day-to-day site operations or enterprise-wide procurement strategy.

Essential Job Functions

  • Serve as the primary procurement and supply chain partner to Data Center Operations teams, Regional COOs, operating leadership, and site leadership.

  • Translate operational requirements into commercial frameworks, supplier strategies, and service delivery models that support uptime expectations, operational constraints, and regional execution realities.

  • Support global procurement and supply chain-enabled data center operating services supporting regional operations teams.

  • Manage global and regional service contracts, including maintenance, repair and maintenance, preventative maintenance, facilities management, security services, specialized technical services, and related operating services.

  • Structure, negotiate, and govern global master service agreements and regional contracts, ensuring clear service definitions, SLAs, escalation structures, recovery commitments, and accountability mechanisms are embedded into agreements.

  • Balance global standardization with regional flexibility to support operating models across multi-region, high-availability environments.

  • Implement commercial strategies that optimize cost, supplier performance, and risk allocation.

  • Operationalize and lead supplier performance governance models, including Quarterly Business Reviews and Strategic Business Reviews.

  • Define and track supplier KPIs across availability, uptime, response and recovery times, SLA compliance, quality, and overall service delivery.

  • Drive continuous improvement with suppliers by leveraging performance data, benchmarking, and contractual levers.

  • Ensure transparent supplier performance reporting and alignment with Operations and COO leadership.

  • Manage procurement execution for repair and maintenance and preventative maintenance services in alignment with Procurement leadership direction.

  • Ensure maintenance contracts enforce defined response times, recovery SLAs, preventative maintenance schedules, OEM standards, asset criticality, and operational uptime objectives.

  • Execute critical spare parts strategies, including inventory approaches, stocking models, supplier frameworks, and rapid fulfillment capabilities.

  • Partner with Operations to align critical spares strategies with failure risk, lead times, and site-level needs while balancing working capital efficiency with uptime protection.

  • Ensure procurement frameworks enable 24/7 emergency response capability across all critical systems.

  • Support Operations during major incident scenarios through supplier mobilization and contractual enforcement.

  • Ensure customer-facing SLAs are embedded into supplier contracts and service delivery frameworks.

  • Partner with Operations to ensure external customer commitments are achievable and supply chain risks are mitigated through effective service design.

  • Manage procurement execution for data center security services, including physical security manpower, guarding, access control personnel, CCTV, surveillance infrastructure, access control systems, software licensing, and upgrades.

  • Ensure security procurement activities comply with enterprise security standards and regulatory requirements.

  • Manage and enhance global frameworks for equipment end-of-life management and lifecycle transitions.

  • Manage programs for recycling, responsible disposal, reuse, and refurbishment where viable.

  • Integrate end-of-life considerations into supplier contracts, total cost of ownership models, capacity planning inputs, and service strategies.

  • Enable and govern systems for asset tracking, asset registries, configuration management, and maintenance and service history integration.

  • Ensure alignment between procurement systems, operational asset data, and service providers to support accurate, real-time asset visibility.

  • Support Operations with asset visibility to improve maintenance planning, spares management, and lifecycle decision-making.

  • Provide procurement and supply chain support for small expansions, in-life capital works, capacity expansions, equipment upgrades, and retrofits.

  • Ensure supplier frameworks enable fast execution, minimal disruption to live operations, standardization, and compliance.

  • Support total cost of ownership optimization across the asset lifecycle.

  • Lead continuous improvement execution across supplier performance, commercial frameworks, and service delivery models.

  • Introduce data-driven and predictive approaches to improve maintenance outcomes, supplier performance, and cost efficiency.

  • Partner closely with Data Center Operations, site leadership, Regional COOs, Procurement and Category Management, Product and Engineering, Supply Chain and Logistics, Security and Risk, Finance and Asset Management, external service providers, and OEMs.

  • Additional duties as assigned by Management

Job Requirements

  • 15+ years of leadership experience in procurement, supply chain, and infrastructure services.

  • Proven experience managing global service agreements and supplier performance frameworks, including QBRs and SBRs.

  • Strong track record supporting operations organizations in uptime-critical environments.

  • Deep understanding of data center systems and lifecycle service requirements.

  • Experience operating in multi-region, high-availability environments.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate operational requirements into procurement execution plans, commercial frameworks, supplier strategies, and service delivery models.

  • Proven ability to structure, negotiate, and manage complex global and regional service contracts.

  • Experience managing supplier performance through KPIs, SLAs, benchmarking, performance data, and contractual levers.

  • Strong understanding of repair and maintenance, preventative maintenance, critical spares, emergency response, and service readiness requirements in mission-critical environments.

  • Experience supporting procurement strategies for data center security services, including physical security manpower and technical security systems.

  • Knowledge of equipment lifecycle management, end-of-life planning, recycling, reuse, refurbishment, and sustainability or regulatory compliance considerations.

  • Experience enabling or governing asset tracking, lifecycle visibility, configuration management, and service history systems.

  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to optimize cost, performance, risk allocation, and total cost of ownership.

  • Ability to balance global standardization with regional flexibility across complex operating models.

  • Proven ability to serve as a strategic execution partner to Operations, Regional COOs, site leadership, executive stakeholders, and cross-functional teams.

  • Travel required is expected to be up to 30% but may increase over time as the business evolves

Physical Demands and Special Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to handle, or feel objects; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; balance; stoop or kneel; talk and hear. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.

Additional Details

  • Salary Range: $270,000-$290,000 Base + Bonus (this range is based on Colorado market data and may vary in other locations)

  • This position is eligible for company benefits including but not limited to medical, dental, and vision coverage, life and AD&D, short and long-term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, participation in a 401k program that includes company match, and many other additional voluntary benefits.

  • Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including your qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience and may fall outside of the range shown.

· 3–5 Tage/Woche, zunächst für 6 Monate mit Option auf Verlängerung

deine aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst unsere Club App weiter und bindest sie an die Shopify Storefront-/Admin-APIs an.

  • Du setzt einzelne Features eigenverantwortlich um – von der Konzeption bis zum Release.

  • Du entwickelst Web-Anwendungen mit TypeScript, React und serverseitigem Rendering (Hydrogen / Next.js).

  • Du entscheidest – im Sparring mit unserem Team – welcher technische Ansatz zu einer Anforderung passt.

  • Optional: Du unterstützt punktuell bei der Weiterentwicklung unseres Shopify-Webshops (Themes, Functions, Extensions).

Freue dich auf spannende Themen

In unserem App-Team stehen laufend spannende Herausforderungen an – zum Beispiel:


  • Wishlist / Merkzettel – plattformübergreifend synchron zwischen App und Storefront

  • Omnichannel & Loyalty – Verzahnung unserer Club-Vorteile über Online- und Offline-Touchpoints

  • Internationalisierung – mehrsprachige und mehrregionale Erlebnisse über App und Storefront hinweg

  • Tracking & Analytics – saubere, DSGVO-konforme Datenerfassung

dein profil

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der professionellen Web- oder Full-Stack-Entwicklung

  • Du hast bereits mit Shopify gearbeitet und verstehst die Möglichkeiten, Grenzen und typischen Lösungsansätze der Plattform.

  • Du arbeitest sicher mit TypeScript und React und hast Erfahrung mit serverseitig gerenderten React-Anwendungen (Hydrogen, Next.js oder vergleichbar).

  • Wartbare Architektur, Tests und saubere Codequalität gehören für dich selbstverständlich zu professioneller Softwareentwicklung.

  • Du nutzt LLMs und AI-Tools produktiv, prüfst ihre Ergebnisse kritisch und kannst Lösungen auch selbst entwickeln und beurteilen.

  • Du arbeitest eigenständig, pragmatisch und strukturiert – ohne Micromanagement – und kommunizierst technische Entscheidungen verständlich.

  • Du sprichst gut Deutsch und/oder Englisch.

Ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung

  • Erfahrung mit Flutter und hybriden App-Architekturen (eingebettete Web-Apps in Native)

  • Shopify Theme Development (Liquid), Shopify Functions & Extensions – damit du bei Bedarf auch unseren Webshop mit weiterentwickeln kannst


Du musst nicht jeden Bereich unseres Stacks beherrschen. Wichtig sind uns ein gutes Shopify- und Hydrogen/React-Verständnis, starke Full-Stack-Grundlagen und die Fähigkeit, dich schnell in neue Technologien einzuarbeiten.

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Associate Director Strategic Planning and Operations

What you will do

Global Patient Safety is a patient-first organization advancing how safety is monitored, understood, and acted upon through data, digital innovation, and emerging technologies. As a trusted enterprise partner, GPS influences critical business decisions by integrating patient insights, scientific expertise, and regulatory excellence. This is an opportunity to join a high-performing team shaping the future of modern patient safety and its impact on patients worldwide.

The Strategic Planning and Operations Associate Director serves as a senior partner to the Vice President of Global Patient Safety and the GPS Executive Leadership Team. Acting as a trusted advisor to the VP, this role connects priorities, initiatives, and decisions across the organization to ensure alignment with broader Amgen priorities. This role operates at the center of GPS leadership, translating strategy into clear priorities, operating plans, leadership routines, executive communications, and measurable outcomes.

The Associate Director leads a team of Strategic Planning and Operations colleagues who support leaders and teams across GPS, ensuring consistent, high-quality planning and operational support across the department. This role strengthens the GPS operating rhythm, drives accountability across leadership priorities, enables effective decision-making, and proactively identifies interdependencies, risks, and opportunities before they impact execution.

This is a highly visible role for an enterprise-minded operator who can partner closely with the VP of Global Patient Safety and help the Executive Leadership Team convert priorities into disciplined execution. The role requires strong business judgment, executive presence, proactive ownership, and the ability to operate effectively in ambiguity. The successful candidate will anticipate leadership needs, synthesize diverse inputs into clear deliverables, bring forward recommendations, and independently advance priorities with minimal direction.

Key Responsiblities:

  • Serve as a thought partner to the VP of Global Patient Safety and GPS Executive Leadership Team, helping shape priorities, identify risks and opportunities, and translate strategy into action.
  • Lead and develop Strategic Planning and Operations colleagues who support leaders and teams across GPS, ensuring aligned priorities, consistent practices, and strong execution across the SPO community.
  • Lead the GPS operating rhythm, including leadership team meetings, business reviews, goal tracking, decision forums, and follow-up mechanisms.
  • Prepare senior leadership discussions by framing objectives, key decisions, tradeoffs, risks, stakeholder considerations, and recommended next steps.
  • Develop executive-level narratives, talking points, presentations, and communications that clearly articulate GPS priorities, progress, decisions, and implications.
  • Drive accountability across GPS by clarifying owners, milestones, dependencies, decisions, and escalation needs.
  • Partner across GPS, R&D SPO leadership, HR, Finance, and other functions to ensure GPS priorities are represented and aligned with broader enterprise objectives.
  • Lead annual and multi-year planning, financial planning, resource planning, and business operations processes for GPS.
  • Design and drive implementation of key GPS initiatives, process improvements, and operating model enhancements.
  • Support GPS communication, engagement, and change management efforts, including leadership messaging, all-staff presentations, and business performance updates.
  • Undertake activities delegated by the QPPV as detailed in the PV System Master File and support ongoing inspection readiness, as applicable.

Knowledge and Skills

  • Strong business judgment and enterprise mindset, with the ability to connect priorities, risks, tradeoffs, and execution implications.
  • Demonstrated ability to synthesize complex information, develop a clear point of view, formulate recommendations, and drive implementation.
  • Strong executive communication skills, including the ability to develop clear narratives, presentations, talking points, and decision materials for senior audiences.
  • Proven ability to operate proactively in ambiguity, anticipate business needs, and move work forward without waiting for detailed direction.
  • Ability to influence across a matrixed organization and create alignment among senior stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and develop Strategic Planning and Operations colleagues.
  • Strong facilitation and operating rhythm skills, with the ability to design leadership discussions that drive decisions, accountability, and progress.
  • High degree of ownership, initiative, accountability, discretion, and professional maturity.

Competencies:

  • Strategic Thinking
  • Executive Communication
  • Influence and Collaboration
  • Leadership and Talent Development
  • Decision Quality
  • Drive for Results
  • Accountability and Ownership
  • Change Leadership

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The dynamic professional we seek is a leader with these qualifications.

Doctorate degree and 3 years of relevant experience

OR

Master’s degree and 5 years of relevant experience

OR

Bachelor’s degree and 7 years of relevant experience

OR

OR

High school diploma / GED and 14 years of relevant experience

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced degree such as MBA, PharmD, PhD, Master’s Degree, or equivalent experience preferred.

  • Pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry experience, preferably in Patient Safety, Pharmacovigilance, Research and Development, Regulatory, Medical, or related areas.
  • Experience translating priorities into operating plans, business reviews, decision forums, and measurable outcomes.
  • Experience developing executive-level narratives, presentations, talking points, and decision materials.

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

Frontier offers benefits, programs and travel privileges designed to support eligible employees at work and beyond. Availability may vary by role, employment status, eligibility, location, schedule, applicable policies and current plan details.

About Frontier Airlines

Frontier Airlines is a Denver-based airline serving destinations across the United States and select international markets. Our people support every part of the travel journey, from airport operations and flight crews to aircraft maintenance, customer support, corporate teams and more.

We’re focused on delivering meaningful value by making travel more accessible, practical and easy to personalize for our customers. Across the airline, our teams help support a safe, reliable and efficient operation while continuing to strengthen the experience for the people who choose Frontier.

What Will You Be Doing?

The Manager, Training & Knowledge Management owns training, readiness, communication, and Knowledge Base strategy across all Customer Care channels and BPO partner operations. This role ensures frontline teams, vendor partners, supervisors, and leaders have accurate training, current knowledge content, clear operational communications, and readiness support needed to deliver consistent, efficient, and customer-focused service.

Essential Functions

  • Develop and maintain Customer Care training programs, certifications, onboarding standards, continuing education, and readiness materials across voice, chat, back office, specialty support, recovery, escalations, complaints, and BPO operations.
  • Own Knowledge Base governance, content accuracy, content freshness, usability, article standards, and ongoing updates in partnership with policy owners and business stakeholders.
  • Lead policy rollouts, process changes, operational communications, and frontline readiness plans for vendors and internal Care teams.
  • Ensure alignment between training, KB content, quality expectations, operational execution, and customer experience goals.
  • Identify training and knowledge gaps using QA findings, customer complaints, escalation trends, CSAT drivers, performance data, and operational feedback.
  • Partner with Operations, Quality, Digital, Customer Experience, Airport Operations, specialty departments, process owners, and vendor learning teams on readiness initiatives and continuous improvement.
  • Establish vendor training governance standards, review training effectiveness, conduct audits, and support consistent delivery across outsourced partner locations.
  • Translate complex policy, process, and product changes into clear training materials, job aids, quick reference guides, readiness toolkits, and agent-friendly communications.

Other Functions

  • Support special projects, customer experience initiatives, operational pilots, and cross-functional readiness activities as assigned.
  • Participate in stakeholder meetings, vendor business reviews, process reviews, and operational planning sessions related to training, communications, and knowledge management.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned to support Customer Care Operations.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Communications, Education, Organizational Development, Training, or a related field required; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
  • Five or more years of experience in contact center operations, learning and development, training leadership, instructional design, knowledge management, vendor operations, or customer service operations required.
  • Experience supporting airline, travel, hospitality, customer service, or outsourced contact center environments preferred.
  • Experience supporting large-scale BPO operations, multi-site vendor teams, or global contact center partners preferred.
  • Experience with Learning Management Systems, knowledge management platforms, Microsoft 365 tools, reporting dashboards, and content authoring tools preferred.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Strong knowledge of adult learning theory, instructional design methodology, curriculum development, training delivery, and learning effectiveness measurement.
  • Knowledge of contact center operations, BPO vendor management, customer experience drivers, quality programs, escalation handling, complaint trends, and frontline enablement.
  • Ability to build scalable training programs, governance routines, communication frameworks, and knowledge management processes across multiple vendors and channels.
  • Ability to analyze QA, complaints, CSAT, operational performance, and knowledge usage data to identify root causes and develop corrective learning plans.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to convert complex operational changes into clear, agent-friendly materials.
  • Strong stakeholder management, cross-functional influence, change management, project management, and continuous improvement skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and drive readiness across internal teams and external vendor partners.

Light physical effort. Primarily sedentary work with regular use of a computer and standard office equipment.

Works under general direction. Receives guidance on objectives and priorities while exercising independent judgment in planning, execution, vendor engagement, and cross-functional coordination.

jobs.description:
About us:
Devlight is the AI partner for companies moving from manual work to intelligent operations.
We design and build AI agents, intelligent workflows, and product experiences that reduce manual effort, improve decision-making, and strengthen customer experience.
Built on a decade of delivering digital products used by millions, we bring product discipline to AI, designing systems that teams can operate, trust, and improve over time.
Our clients: Nova Poshta, Sense Bank, Aurora, OKWINE, NOVUS, VARUS, BROCARD, Dnipro-M, and many others.

About the role:
Devlight builds AI systems for enterprise clients, from discovery and architecture through release and production operation.
We are hiring an engineer to build agentic systems. The current engagement is a conversational agent inside a client product with a large user base: the agent interprets the request, decides which tools to call, retrieves data from the client's systems through typed contracts, streams the response into the application, and returns structured actions the application executes itself.
The system is already designed: there is an architecture vision with C1–C3 views, ADRs for every key decision, tool contracts, and specifications for guardrails, grounding, and evaluation methodology. A solution architect owns the architecture and the project tech lead runs day-to-day supervision. Your part is implementation and getting it to release against a written specification.
Technical context: TypeScript / Node.js (NestJS), Anthropic API, streaming to the client, Postgres and Redis, Kubernetes on AWS, end-to-end observability on OpenTelemetry.
This is a project hire of about 3 months, with the scope likely to expand. After successful delivery, the collaboration continues on other projects at the company.

Your future responsibilities:
  • Build the agent core: the think–act–observe loop, tool selection, session state, layered prompts with caching
  • Implement the agent's tools and the call runtime: typed contracts, retries, timeouts, error mapping
  • Guardrails and grounding: input filtering, response validation against retrieved data, safe fallbacks for every failure mode
  • Streaming to the client: incremental delivery, structured action events for the application, reconnection and backpressure
  • Evaluation: assemble datasets, build the run harness, wire regression gates before releases and before any model or prompt change
  • Observability: tracing, cost and latency metrics, dashboards, incident analysis from traces
  • Extend the stack where the work calls for it: vector and hybrid retrieval, multimodal input, streaming voice
  • Work from written specifications and keep them current

Your professional qualities:
  • 5+ years of professional experience as a software engineer.
  • At least one agent you took to production with real users.
  • Tool design: granularity, argument and response schemas, error and timeout handling, how the agent behaves when a call fails.
  • Multi-step loops and context: layered prompt structure with caching, session and conversation state, parallel tool calls, recovery after failure, token and latency budgets.
  • LLM APIs at the level of detail: tool use, structured outputs, streaming, prompt caching, limits and retries.
  • Grounding and guardrails: validating responses against the source, input filtering, off-topic and jailbreak handling, discipline around personal data.
  • Choosing the grounding approach for the data at hand: direct tool calls or RAG, with the decision argued.
  • Evaluation as a practice: test case sets, automated grading with LLM-as-judge, regression gates before a release and before any prompt or model change.
  • Tracing and metrics: every model call and tool call as a span, cost and latency per conversation, diagnosing an incident from the trace.
  • Production backend work in TypeScript / Node.js: NestJS or a comparable framework, REST, streaming over SSE or WebSocket, Postgres and Redis.
  • Claude Code (or a comparable agentic coding tool) in daily use: subagents, skills, hooks, MCP, defining repository conventions.
  • Spec-driven development: specifications and contracts come before code, decisions are captured in ADRs, documentation is updated alongside changes.

Nice to have:
  • Full-stack: internal interfaces in React / TypeScript (metrics dashboards, conversation browsing, prompt version management) — with this, one person covers the whole role.
  • Deeper RAG mechanics: chunking and metadata, embedding model selection, hybrid retrieval, reranking, retrieval metrics (recall@k, MRR / nDCG).
  • Search in production: Elasticsearch or OpenSearch at the relevance-tuning level, pgvector.
  • Multimodal models and streaming speech-to-text: CLIP / SigLIP class embeddings, vision models, latency budgeting for a voice pipeline.
  • Evaluation and observability tooling: Promptfoo, LangSmith, Langfuse, Braintrust, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki.
  • Infrastructure and data: Kubernetes, Terraform, queues, BigQuery and analytical pipelines.
  • Products with a large user base, where latency and cost per interaction matter.
What we offer for your success:
  • Fully remote or hybrid work format.
  • Paid Time Off, sick days, regular reward evaluations, and accounting support.
  • Reimbursement for training courses and compensation for the use of personal equipment.
  • IT Club Loyalty Card.
  • Work with an open-minded team that welcomes your new ideas, alongside the best specialists who love sharing their experience.
  • Get the chance to connect with top companies and contribute to the growth of the Ukrainian IT community together.
Our recruitment process:
Recruiter Interview ✅ Tech Interview ✅ Reference Check ✅ Offer ✅
Ready to become a part of Devlight? Go ahead and send us your CV. We’ll be thrilled to welcome you to the team!

Overview:

At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges.

Come make an impact every day at Zebra.

What We're Looking For:

Computer Vision Intern

About the Role

Are you passionate about bridging the gap between theoretical computer vision and real-world industrial applications? Zebra Technologies is looking for a driven Computer Vision & AI Intern to join our Advanced Data Capture team for a 3-month part-time internship.

In this role, you will work closely with our expert team of Algorithm Researchers and Software Engineers to develop, optimize, and test next-generation algorithms for 2D barcode detection and decoding. You will gain hands-on experience navigating the complexities of industrial image processing—from classical computer vision techniques to cutting-edge deep learning models—all while writing robust implementation code in Python and C/C++.

Key Responsibilities

  • Algorithm Development: Assist in researching, designing, and testing algorithms for robust barcode detection and decoding in challenging conditions (e.g., blur, low illumination, complex backgrounds).
  • Hybrid Approaches: Work on both Classical Computer Vision (feature extraction, grid building, signal analysis) and Deep Learning-based methods for image classification and localization.
  • Pipeline Optimization: Contribute to the end-to-end 2D barcode decoding pipeline, writing efficient and maintainable implementation code in Python and C/C++.
  • Data Experimentation: Help evaluate model performance and potentially assist with synthetic data generation pipelines to improve algorithm robustness against realistic degradations (like ink spread or curvature).
  • Collaboration: Participate in technical reviews and collaborate directly with senior algorithm researchers and software engineers.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Currently pursuing a BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or a highly related field.
  • Strong theoretical understanding of image processing and Computer Vision fundamentals.
  • Hands-on proficiency in Python and C/C++.
  • Familiarity with at least one major deep learning framework (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow).
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to dedicate 20 hours per week for the 3-month duration.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior academic or project experience related to Direct Part Marking (DPM) or barcode scanning technologies.
  • Understanding of optimization techniques for deploying CV algorithms in C/C++.
  • A strong portfolio or GitHub repository showcasing relevant computer vision projects.

  • Evaluate, test, and implement Workday releases, new functionality, and system enhancements to improve organizational learning capabilities and user experience.

    •

Learning Operations & Content Administration

  • Administer enterprise learning programs, compliance training, certifications, curricula, learning pathways, and other learning initiatives within Workday Learning.
  • Create, publish, update, archive, and maintain instructor-led, virtual, blended, and eLearning content while ensuring accurate course data, metadata, version control, and user accessibility.

Reporting, Analytics, & Data Management

System Enhancements, Integrations, & Technical Support

jobs.description:
With minimal supervision, the NPI Sourcing Buyer is responsible for procurement and sourcing activities that support Ezurio's new product introduction (NPI) programs. This includes issuing and managing purchase orders, tracking deliveries, and expediting materials for prototype, pilot, and production-ramp builds. The role also sources new component solutions — including electronics, sheet metal, displays, cables, shielding, and PCBs — in close partnership with the Strategic Sourcing, Engineering, and Project Management teams to drive successful, on-time, on-cost new product launches. The NPI Sourcing Buyer also supports production-level buying activities as capacity allows. This position is remote within the U.S. Legal authorization to work in the US is required.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Issue, maintain, and expedite purchase orders for NPI materials, prototypes, and engineering builds; track deliveries and proactively resolve delays that put program milestones at risk.
  • Partner with Engineering and Project Management throughout the NPI lifecycle (concept, prototype, pilot, and production ramp) to ensure timely availability of materials and components.
  • Source new component solutions across commodities such as electronics, sheet metal, displays, cables, shielding, and PCBs; identify, evaluate, and qualify new suppliers for these solutions.
  • Collaborate with the Strategic Sourcing team to align new sourcing activity with category strategies, negotiated pricing, and preferred supplier agreements.
  • Work with Engineering to translate BOM and specification requirements into sourcing requirements, and support design-for-cost and design-for-supply-chain decisions during development.
  • Retrieve and manage fabrication, Gerber, and BOM data from the PLM system (Arena, Agile, Up Chain, or Equivalent) to support new-build sourcing and engineering change orders (ECOs).
  • Manage supplier communication, RFQs, samples, and lead-time commitments for new and existing NPI parts.
  • Track and report NPI procurement status, supply risks, and material readiness to Project Management and cross-functional program teams.
  • Support production-level buying and planning activities (purchase orders, supplier schedules, MRP action messages) as time and priorities allow.
  • Support MRO purchasing for manufacturing sites
  • Maintain accurate purchase order, pricing, and delivery data within the ERP/MRP system (NetSuite).
  • Monitor and resolve supply issues that could impact new product launch schedules; escalate risks early to Engineering, Project Management, and Strategic Sourcing.
  • Support cost-reduction, dual-sourcing, and supplier consolidation initiatives identified during NPI sourcing activity.
  • Adheres to Ezurio quality and safety systems / safety standards.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Previous experience in purchasing, sourcing, or supply chain, ideally supporting new product development or NPI programs.
  • Engineering background, technical degree, or equivalent hands-on experience strongly preferred, along with familiarity with electronics manufacturing in an OEM environment.
  • Working knowledge of electronic components, sheet metal, displays, cables, shielding, and PCBs, and their sourcing and manufacturing processes.
  • Hands-on experience with PLM or engineering document-management systems (Arena, Agile, Up Chain, or equivalent) for fabrication / Gerber / BOM retrieval and version control.
  • Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills; comfortable working closely with Engineering, Project Management, and Strategic Sourcing teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent NPI programs and shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to read and interpret BOMs, engineering drawings, and component specifications.
  • Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Excel; experience with ERP/MRP systems (NetSuite preferred).
  • Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions (P/D/C/A).
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills and disciplined follow-up.

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE

  • BS in Engineering, Supply Chain, or a related field preferred, or equivalent hands-on experience.
  • 3-5 years of experience in procurement, sourcing, or supply chain, preferably within an electronics manufacturing or OEM environment.
  • Experience supporting new product introduction (NPI) or new product development programs preferred.

jobs.excerpt: About UsAt Cast & Crew, we’ve empowered creativity and supported the global entertainment industry for decades.
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cast & Crew, we’ve empowered creativity and supported the global entertainment industry for decades. Together with our family of brands - Backstage, CAPS, Checks & Balances, Final Draft, Media Services, Sargent-Disc, and The TEAM Companies – we operate as a combined entertainment technology and services provider offering industry standard screenwriting accounting software, digital payroll products, data & reporting, and a host of creative tools. The industry continues to move faster than ever, and the need for our expertise, our technology, and our people has never been greater. We are a production’s best ally every step of the way. #OneCastOneCrew

Position Overview

We are looking for a strategic and hands-on Security Operations (SecOps) Manager to lead our security operations team in protecting the endpoints, identities, email, and corporate data that power the entertainment industry's payroll and financial operations. This role is critical to detecting, responding to, and preventing security threats against the systems and data that our clients—major studios, streaming platforms, and production companies—rely on every day.

As the SecOps Manager, you will lead a team responsible for security monitoring, incident response, endpoint protection, email security, identity security and governance, and security awareness. You'll work at the intersection of security operations, threat detection, and incident management, partnering closely with IT, engineering, and business teams to ensure rapid response to threats and continuous improvement of our security posture.

This is a leadership role for someone who is equally comfortable setting operational strategy, mentoring team members, and rolling up their sleeves to investigate complex security incidents. You will manage a team of security analysts and engineers, drive our security operations maturity, lead incident response efforts, and champion a security-first culture across the organization.

Core Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive security operations strategy aligned with business objectives and risk tolerance

  • Define the roadmap for security monitoring, detection, and response capabilities across the enterprise

  • Partner with IT and infrastructure teams to embed security monitoring and controls across the systems they own and administer

  • Establish and mature incident response processes, playbooks, and escalation procedures

  • Own the operational security metrics—detection and response times, endpoint coverage and compliance, phishing resilience—that feed our established executive security KPI program, reporting progress to the CISO

  • Participate in proofs of concept and design partnerships with emerging security vendors — particularly AI-driven technologies — helping evaluate new products and shape their roadmaps alongside security leadership

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of security analysts and engineers

  • Foster a collaborative, learning-oriented team culture that balances security rigor with operational efficiency

  • Conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and career development planning for direct reports

  • Scale the team as the organization grows, including hiring and onboarding new security talent

  • Provide technical guidance and remove blockers to enable your team's success

Security Operations & Incident Response

  • Oversee security monitoring and SIEM operations, ensuring effective detection and alerting

  • Lead incident response efforts, conducting investigations, root cause analysis, and implementing preventive measures

  • Serve as the escalation point for critical and after-hours security incidents, and manage on-call rotations and escalation workflows for the team

  • Manage endpoint detection and response (EDR) platforms and endpoint security posture

  • Oversee email security operations including anti-phishing, anti-malware, and email gateway management

  • Lead security awareness and training programs to reduce human risk factors

  • Develop and maintain incident response playbooks, runbooks, and tabletop exercises

  • Manage day-to-day operational relationships with security tooling vendors and managed service providers

Identity Security & Governance

  • Define identity security policy and standards — single sign-on (SSO), multi-factor authentication (MFA), and conditional access requirements — for the identity platforms administered by IT

  • Monitor user and permissions hygiene across the enterprise, including joiner/mover/leaver lifecycle and least-privilege enforcement, driving remediation with IT

  • Lead periodic access reviews and certification campaigns in partnership with IT and GRC

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with IT and infrastructure teams to ensure security tools integrate effectively with enterprise systems

  • Partner with the GRC team on SOC 2 compliance requirements related to security operations, including control evidence and audit support

  • Collaborate with the Product Security team on monitoring, detection, and response for application-layer threats

  • Communicate security risks, incidents, and priorities effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Key Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in security operations, incident response, or related security roles, including 3+ years directly managing security teams (hiring, performance management, and career development)

  • Deep technical expertise in at least two of the following areas:

    • Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) administration and log analysis

    • Incident response and digital forensics

    • Endpoint detection and response (EDR) platforms

    • Email security and anti-phishing technologies

    • Identity security and governance, including IdP policy design (e.g., Okta, Microsoft Entra ID), SSO/MFA/conditional access, and access lifecycle governance

    • Security awareness and training program management

  • Strong understanding of common attack vectors, threat intelligence, and detection methodologies

  • Experience developing and executing incident response playbooks and tabletop exercises

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex security concepts to diverse audiences

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field (or equivalent practical experience)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Industry certifications such as CISSP, GCIH, GCFA, GCIA, or Security+

  • Experience in regulated industries (finance, healthcare, entertainment) with compliance requirements

  • Familiarity with SOAR platforms and security automation

  • Experience with cloud security monitoring (AWS, Azure)

  • Knowledge of threat hunting and proactive detection techniques

  • Experience managing managed security service provider (MSSP) relationships

  • Experience supporting SOC 2 audits

  • Experience with proofs of concept or design partnerships with emerging security vendors, particularly AI-based tooling

Key Competencies & Attributes

  • Strategic thinker who can balance long-term vision with short-term execution

  • Collaborative leader who builds trust and influence across teams

  • Calm under pressure with the ability to lead effectively during security incidents

  • Pragmatic problem-solver who understands business context and risk tradeoffs

  • Continuous learner who stays current with evolving threats, tools, and best practices

  • Clear communicator who can articulate security priorities to executives and board members

  • Empathetic manager who invests in team growth and creates psychological safety

Special Work Conditions

  • Sedentary – Involves sitting most of the time but may involve walking or standing for brief periods of time. Some positions may entail exerting up to 15 lbs. of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force to lift, carry, push, or pull.

  • Travel up to 5%

Benefits

Cast & Crew provides a comprehensive package of employee benefits including: Medical, Dental, Vision, PTO, health and wellness programs, employee discounts, and more! Note: Cast & Crew benefits are subject to eligibility requirements.

It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all individuals based on job-related qualifications and ability to perform a job, without regard to age, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, creed, national origin, disability, genetic information, veteran status, citizenship or marital status, and to maintain a non-discriminatory environment free from intimidation, harassment or bias based upon these grounds.

The Risk Analyst sidetracks risks to cost, schedule, and performance, keeps the risk register updated, and reports risk status to program leadership and the customer.

Most of the week is spent with the delivery team. The rest goes to collecting risk data from the program team, updating the register, and writing the risk sections of weekly and monthly reports.

Primary Responsibilities

What You Will Do: Scrum Master

  • Run daily standups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Coach the team on Scrum and SAFe practices.
  • Find and clear roadblocks. Raise the ones the team cannot fix on its own.
  • Support Planning Interval planning, including prep work, dependencies, and what the team commits to.
  • Work with other teams on shared or dependent work.
  • Track team metrics such as velocity, burndown, and how well the team meets commitments, and use them to improve.
  • Keep the team focused and the workload manageable during busy periods.
  • Keep the backlog, board, and tools up to date.

What You Will Do: Risk Analyst

  • Review risk data to find risks to cost, schedule, and performance, both in specific areas and across the program.
  • Work with the program team to collect and check risk data.
  • Keep the risk register current, including the risk, how likely it is, its impact, who owns it, and the plan to reduce it.
  • Write and brief risk status for program leadership and the customer, in writing, in charts, and in person.
  • Follow mitigation actions until they are closed and report on what risk is left.
  • Help manage issues and escalations when a risk actually happens.
  • Write the risk sections of weekly and monthly reports and other deliverables.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • Five (5) years of relevant work experience.
  • Experience as a Scrum Master for a delivery team.
  • Working knowledge of SAFe Lean-Agile principles and practices.
  • Experience reviewing risk data and identifying risks to cost, schedule, and performance.
  • Experience writing and briefing status reports for leadership.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain the required VA background investigation.

Desired Qualifications

  • Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), SAFe Scrum Master (SSM), or Professional Scrum Master (PSM).
  • PMI-RMP, PMP, or a similar certification.
  • Experience supporting VA, VHA, DoD, or other federal health programs.
  • Experience on an electronic health record rollout or improvement effort.
  • Experience with Jira or Azure DevOps, plus Microsoft 365 and SharePoint.
  • Experience with government contract deliverables and reporting.

What Makes Someone Successful Here

  • Can run a meeting and keep people moving without being their boss.
  • Comfortable working with numbers and data, not just conversations.
  • Speaks and writes clearly for technical, clinical, and executive audiences.
  • Follows through until roadblocks and risks are actually closed out.
  • Sees both what the team is doing today and what the program needs down the road.

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

We embrace complex challenges with curiosity, having genuine interest and drive to understand the hard problems at hand and how to move the needle forward. Our engineers empower each other to take action, learn deeply about our customers' needs and unlock innovation with a strong sense of product ownership. We build with our users in mind, thoughtfully shipping outcomes, not just features. The technology we build shapes real healthcare decisions, demanding a high bar for engineering excellence and what we ship carries real weight. We pressure-test new AI tools, shape how they're used, and set the example for what disciplined, AI-driven engineering looks like...fast, but always under structured human oversight.

The Role

This is a full-stack role with a backend center of gravity. You'll spend the majority of your time designing and building the backend systems and APIs that power our web products. but you're equally comfortable moving up the stack to build the user-facing features those systems support. We're looking for an engineer who can own a feature end to end, from data model to UI, while bringing real depth on the backend. You'll leverage your deep programming expertise to design and build scalable, reliable web application systems — working alongside AI coding agents as a core part of how you deliver, directing and reviewing their output while holding the bar on quality. The ideal candidate has strong experience in application design and system architecture, along with a proven ability to drive adoption of new languages, tools, and agentic development practices across a team.

You'll join a highly visible engineering team trusted to solve complex, high-stakes problems using the best of AI, data and software systems. You're responsible for writing code that has a significant impact on our customers and future product lines. Our team partners cross-functionally to influence product direction, work directly with customers, and own systems positively impacting millions of lives, where your technical decisions truly matter.

Click here to learn more about our product lines.

  • Deepen your understanding in the healthcare claims and payments domain
  • Developer Coach/Multiplier - An experienced Java, Scala and/or Rust developer who not only builds production-grade services, but also contributes to setting standards, mentors others, and elevates the team’s overall programming maturity.

  • Design systems that work together to deliver a good-performing, reliable application
  • Bring agentic engineering practices into the team’s day-to-day work and help the team adopt them effectively

What You Bring

  • 10+ years of experience spread across both frontend and backend programming
  • Proven experience designing and shipping customer-facing web application products, you've built features that serve external users and you're energized by that kind of work!
  • Experienced in Rust, Java, or Scala with additional strengths across UI development.
  • The ability to write a Technical Design Document (TDD) that a staff peer trusts and a product lead can understand — turning ambiguous product intent into concrete backend design
  • A product and user-driven mindset. You connect your technical decisions to the people using what you build, and you care about the outcome, not just the implementation
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills with your engineering peers, senior PM, ML/DS partners, and leadership. You care more about the system landing than about being right.
  • A pragmatic default paired with a strong systems instinct – you look for root causes, not symptoms.
  • Hands-on experience with agentic engineering tools and workflows in a real production setting.
  • Experience reading and understanding complex code, owning code quality and improving it
  • Critical thinking and problem solving skills working in a high growth environment where stakes are high
  • Comfort with complexity and curiosity to define the path forward, not wait for one

What We Offer

  • FSA/HSA
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Competitive salary, 401(k) with company match
  • Unlimited PTO

How We Evaluate Talent

Our interview process is designed to evaluate candidates across our engineering career ladder. The level, title, and compensation range we're able to offer are determined by your overall performance and the competencies you demonstrate throughout the process which allows us to place each candidate at the level that best reflects their experience and abilities!

The salary for this position is based on an array of factors unique to each candidate: Such as years and depth of experience, set skills, certifications, etc. We are hiring for different levels, and our Recruiting team will let you know if you qualify for a different role/range. Salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes meaningful equity, excellent healthcare, flexible time off, and other benefits and perks.

We are seeking an experienced, true full stack Developer/Tester who can own an application end to end: Angular front-end, .NET API and backend services, SQL Server data layer, and automated testing.
