jobs.excerpt: This is a remote position. About Us:Berkeley Payments is a leading payment technology provider specializing in innovative solutions for businesses to manage and process payments seamlessly.
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

About Us:

Berkeley Payments is a leading payment technology provider specializing in innovative solutions for businesses to manage and process payments seamlessly. We power prepaid card and disbursement programs for some of Canada's largest enterprises, including major banks, payroll providers, and government programs, alongside 400+ generic card programs. We pride ourselves on combining deep payments expertise with modern technology to help our clients launch and scale payment programs that would otherwise take years to build.

Role Overview:

We are looking for a high-impact Senior Manager, Client Operations to own how Berkeley runs day two and beyond. Implementation gets a program live. This role keeps it running.

You will own every inbound channel into Berkeley: client support requests from enterprise program administrators, cardholder support across phone, IVR, email, and chat, and the technical escalations that surface behind both. You will lead the internal support team and the third party providers that extend it, and you will be the single accountable owner for service levels, first contact resolution, and cost to serve.

This role sits at the intersection of technical incident management, regulated fintech operations, and enterprise client communication. When a live program breaks, you run the response: you coordinate internal engineering, external processors and issuing banks, and client communication in parallel, then you write and defend the Root Cause Analysis in front of the client. When nothing is broken, you are rebuilding the support layer itself, migrating contact centre infrastructure, deploying Agentic AI and automated workflows, and driving unit costs down while resolution quality goes up.

This is not a ticket queue management role. You need enough payments and platform fluency to triage a transaction decline or a PIN retrieval failure without waiting on engineering, and enough operational discipline to run a regulated support function that enterprise clients and their auditors will scrutinise.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Service Level Ownership: Own the operating metrics for the support function end to end, including first contact resolution, average speed of answer, average handle time, backlog aging, SLA attainment, client satisfaction, and cost per contact. Provide a single source of truth on support performance to executive leadership.

  • Cost to Serve: Own unit cost to serve across the portfolio and drive it down structurally through automation, self-serve deflection, knowledge management, and channel mix, not through service degradation.

  • Technical Incident Command: Serve as incident commander for production issues affecting live programs. Coordinate internal engineering, external processors, and issuing bank counterparts under time pressure while running client and cardholder communication in parallel. Own severity classification, escalation paths, and status cadence.

  • Root Cause Analysis: Own the RCA process. Ensure RCAs are technically accurate, delivered inside committed timelines, and defensible when presented to enterprise client stakeholders and their risk teams. Drive corrective actions to closure rather than filing the document and moving on.

  • Enterprise Operational Partnership: Act as the senior operational point of contact for marquee enterprise accounts, partnering with Client Success, who owns the commercial relationship. You own operational delivery, support performance reviews, and the credibility of Berkeley's answer when a client executive asks what happened and what changes.

  • Cardholder Support Operations: Own the cardholder experience across all contact channels, including dispute intake and resolution, complaint handling, card replacement and reissue flows, and identity and account access support. Ensure cardholder outcomes hold up under regulatory and network scrutiny.

  • Vendor and BPO Management: Own the third party support providers and the vendor stack behind them. Set scorecards, run quality assurance and call monitoring, hold vendors to contracted performance, and make the build versus buy versus offshore calls with real numbers behind them.

  • Support Infrastructure Leadership: Lead the modernization of Berkeley's client and cardholder support infrastructure, including CCaaS, telephony and IVR, ticketing, and knowledge base. Own the Go/No-Go decisions, vendor coordination, and cross functional roadmap for each migration.

  • AI and Automation Strategy: Design and implement an AI assisted support layer using Agentic tooling and automated workflows. Decide what gets automated, what stays human, and where an AI answer creates regulatory or reputational risk that is not worth the deflection.

  • Team Leadership: Lead the Client Support and Cardholder Support teams across internal staff and third party providers. Set standards for quality, tone, and technical accuracy. Build the coverage model, on call rotation, and career paths that let the function scale without burning people out.

  • Compliance Partnership: Partner with Compliance to ensure support operations meet FINTRAC, PCMLTFR, and PCI DSS requirements, including dispute handling obligations, network rules, complaint recordkeeping, and cardholder data handling on every channel.

  • Governance and Escalation: Define and enforce the escalation framework between support, engineering, product, and client-facing teams. Protect product and engineering capacity from unscoped support pull through by resolving at the right layer.

  • Process Improvement: Identify and remove systemic drivers of contact volume. Feed recurring failure patterns back into product and engineering as prioritised fixes. Build and maintain the run-books, macros, knowledge base, and reporting frameworks that scale as Berkeley grows.

Qualifications:

  • 8+ years in client operations, support operations, or service delivery leadership within FinTech, payments, or a highly regulated SaaS environment. Payments experience is strongly preferred and regulated environment experience is non-negotiable.

  • Proven experience leading technical incident response for enterprise grade clients, including writing and defending complex RCAs. You must be able to speak engineer and speak to client in the same hour.

  • Direct experience providing operational support to named, high revenue enterprise accounts, including reporting to client side executive stakeholders.

  • Demonstrated people management experience leading support, service delivery, or contact centre teams, including managing third party or outsourced providers against contracted performance.

  • Working knowledge of payments compliance obligations, including AML and KYC, regulatory reporting, financial dispute and chargeback resolution, and PCI DSS constraints on support workflows.

  • Demonstrated success leading infrastructure implementations or migrations such as CCaaS, CRM, telephony, or Agentic AI deployments, with full accountability for vendor performance and outcome.

  • Strategic people operations experience. Not just managing an existing team but building one: designing structure, managing performance transitions, and scaling a workforce through rapid growth.

  • Technical fluency. Deep enough understanding of API-based integrations, card transaction flows, and processor workflows to triage credibly and challenge an engineering diagnosis when it does not hold up.

  • Data discipline. Able to instrument a support function, build the reporting yourself when needed, and make decisions from queue data rather than anecdote.

  • Proficiency with Zoho, Jira, Metabase, or equivalent platforms, and hands on experience with modern LLM based support agents.

  • Exceptional executive communication. Able to hold the room with C level enterprise client stakeholders during and after an incident, and earn their confidence.

  • Strong written communication. RCAs, incident updates, escalation notes, and operating reviews must be clear, concise, and defensible.

  • Comfort pushing back. Willing to tell clients, sales, and senior leadership when a commitment is not operationally deliverable, with the substance to back it up.

  • Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

What We Offer:

At Berkeley Payments, we believe in creating an environment where our team members can thrive both professionally and personally. As a part of our team, you'll benefit from:

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer a salary package that reflects your experience and contributions.

  • Comprehensive Benefits: Enjoy health, dental, and vision coverage, along with paid time off.

  • Fully Remote Environment: We are a fully remote company, allowing you to work from anywhere, in a culture that prioritises output over hours.

  • Ownership and Impact: Be part of a small, agile team where your work has a direct and visible line to client retention and the company's bottom line.

  • Executive Visibility: A seat at the table for critical operational decisions, with regular exposure to the CEO and COO.

  • High-Growth Environment: Lead the transformation of Berkeley's operational layer during a pivotal period of infrastructure migration and AI adoption.

  • Professional Development: We invest in your growth through ongoing learning opportunities, mentorship, and chances to work with cutting-edge technologies.

  • Inclusive Culture: We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone's voice is heard and valued.

  • Exciting Fintech Landscape: Join a dynamic industry at the forefront of payments technology, where you'll tackle complex problems and contribute to innovative solutions that shape the future of fintech.

Don't meet every single requirement?

At Berkeley Payments, we are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description and you have a passion for learning and growth, we encourage you to apply anyway.

We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

We're looking for the person who brings a Forward Deployed Engineering curriculum to life for students: hosts the group live events, reviews the work, runs the solution design and delivery reviews, and sets the technical bar for the people supporting alongside you. The curriculum is built by a team of senior authors.

This is a teaching and reviewing role. You'll be the senior technical presence students learn from week to week. You'll run group live events, give real engineering feedback on student deployment deliverables, and act as the escalation point for a team of supporting instructors who handle first-line questions. The best person for this is someone who has actually gone into client environments and carried AI deployments to production, has opinions about what a sound deployment looks like, and can tell an experienced engineer why their approach is wrong.

Your audience: Working production engineers, not career changers, with six to fifteen years in, mostly backend, with senior and staff engineers and the occasional engineering manager. They've shipped real software for years and are moving deliberately into forward-deployed AI work; some are already interviewing for FDE roles while they study. What they're missing is agentic systems and the client-facing half of delivery.

Format: Group live events, 1:1s, and workshops timed around US Eastern Time – mostly 2:00 PM to 9:00 PM ET. Estimated 15 to 25 hrs/week.

Please submit all resumes or CVs in English.

What you will do

  • Host live events focused on deploying AI systems inside a client's environment: discovery and scoping, agentic architecture, integration with enterprise systems, rollout, and adoption.
  • Run 1:1 sessions and tech mock interviews for students working through projects.
  • Review student projects against rubrics, including the client-facing side of the work: scoping decisions, demos, and how they explain a system to a non-technical stakeholder.
  • Set the technical standard for a team of supporting instructors who cover questions and first-line review, and act as their escalation point.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of professional engineering experience, currently working at senior level or above (Senior/Lead/Staff Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Architect, or technical lead on customer-facing delivery).
  • Has personally owned deployments end-to-end in real client or enterprise environments – first call through production go-live and adoption.
  • Depth across the FDE spine: customer discovery and design sessions, scoping and delivery planning under ambiguity, stakeholder management without formal authority; LLM and agent systems in production (prompting, tool/function calling, orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph/LangChain/CrewAI, guardrails, evals, RAG over enterprise data); APIs and integrations (REST, webhooks, JSON/GraphQL), Python, and deployment on at least one major cloud.
  • Can explain why an architecture or scoping decision was made, not just how it was implemented, and can diagnose and critique someone else's work live.
  • Strong technical communication: translating between technical and business audiences, comfortable leading a live session, whiteboarding a solution, and writing clear, specific review feedback.
  • Strong English C1+ — instruction and review are in English for a US-based audience.
  • Comfortable using AI tools in day-to-day technical work.

Preferred experience:

  • Has taught, mentored, or run technical sessions before: internal tech talks, onboarding, mentoring engineers, bootcamp or workshop instruction.
  • Has worked embedded within a customer team as their primary technical resource, or held a customer-facing engineering role (solutions engineer, solutions architect, technical consultant).
  • Production experience with agentic frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI) and MCP-based tool integrations into client systems.
  • Work experience at a recognizable company.
  • Familiarity with online education platforms or running programs.

What we can offer you

  • Fully remote work, with live sessions scheduled within US afternoon and evening hours.
  • A digital office: we use modern tools (Notion, Slack, Zoom) to keep collaboration smooth.
  • Professional trust and autonomy: no micromanaging.
  • A diverse, international, close-knit team excited to work with you!

About A1

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks that are not AI-native. Our mission is to build a proactive smart assistant for everyday users to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. The system must handle multi-step reasoning, interact with external tools, and remain reliable despite non-deterministic model behavior. Our objective is to help users complete tasks daily enjoyable with over ~90%* reduced time.

Role

As an Android Software Engineer, you own the Android client experience, how AI feels, behaves, and performs on mobile devices. This is not a thin client role. You will build a production Android application where AI interactions are core to the product, and performance, reliability, and clarity matter.

Focus

  • Build and maintain production Android apps using Kotlin.

  • Integrate AI-powered features (chat, vision, voice, recommendations) via backend APIs.

  • Design UX patterns for AI interactions, including streaming responses, retries, and partial results.

  • Optimize performance, memory usage, and responsiveness for AI-heavy flows.

  • Implement analytics, logging, and feedback capture to support AI evaluation and iteration.

  • Collaborate closely with backend and ML engineers on API contracts and system behavior.

  • Ensure app stability, security, and scalability in production environments.

Ideal Experiences

  • 3+ years of Android development experience using Kotlin.

  • Hands-on experience integrating AI features (e.g. LLM, vision, speech APIs).

  • Strong understanding of asynchronous programming (Coroutines, Flow).

  • Familiarity with REST or gRPC APIs and structured data formats.

  • Strong debugging and performance profiling skills.

  • Comfort building in environments with latency, partial failure, and non-deterministic behavior.

  • Experience with MLKit or light on-device inference.

  • Published production apps on the Google Play Store.

Outcomes

  • Stable, smooth, and reliable real-world use android applications.

  • Performance is optimized: responsive, low-latency, and efficient on memory and CPU.

  • Production issues are detected early, monitored effectively, and resolved with clear root-cause analysis.

Tech Stack

  • Kotlin / Java

  • SQL / noSQL

  • TensorFlow Lite (on-device inference)

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About the team and the role:

An eBay subsidiary, TCGplayer is on a quest to be the most trusted trading card game (TCG) platform — connecting and empowering the hobby community. Trading card games are a $25B global market that creates community connection through in-person games (Pokemon; Magic: The Gathering; YuGiOh; etc.). Founded by TCG enthusiasts, we operate a global marketplace, and create tools, technologies and solutions that help small businesses profitably sell TCGs at scale.

As a Principal Product Designer, Design Systems, you will shape the future of TCGplayer's product experience by evolving the shared design system that powers our end-to-end commerce ecosystem—from marketplace experiences and seller tools to fulfillment and robotic inventory digitization systems. You will establish and continuously elevate the visual language, interaction patterns, and experience standards that define our products, helping transform them into cohesive, intuitive, and professional-grade experiences that reflect the quality of an eBay company. Working at the intersection of design, engineering, and technology, you will create the shared foundation that enables teams to deliver exceptional user experiences with greater speed, consistency, and quality while advancing AI-assisted design and development through modern design systems, design tokens, and code-connected workflows.

Our User Experience Design team prides itself on creating a culture that fosters camaraderie, embraces diversity, and exudes passion. We value curiosity, craft, and a desire to directly interact with the real world. You don’t have to be a hobbyist or gamer to love working in TCGplayer’s UX Design organization, but you should be eager to amplify our steadfast commitment to making hobbies and games accessible, fun, and rewarding for everyone. If you’re equal parts “empathy” and “ambition,” this is an opportunity to take risks and stretch yourself, surrounded by teammates who will support you along the way.

What you will accomplish:

  • Own and evolve TCGplayer's design system across our commerce ecosystem, establishing the visual language, interaction patterns, and reusable components that power consistent, high-quality products.

  • Partner closely with Design and Engineering to ensure the design system is implemented consistently across both Figma and code, improving quality, maintainability, and development efficiency.

  • Define and maintain design standards, governance, documentation, and contribution models that enable the system to scale as the organization grows.

  • Advance our design tooling by developing and maintaining component libraries, design tokens, variables, and workflows that improve designer productivity and implementation fidelity.

  • Raise the quality bar across the organization by evolving our visual language, accessibility standards, and UX patterns based on a deep understanding of our customers’ unique needs.

  • Partner with UX Design and Product teams on strategic roadmap initiatives, design sprints, and vision work to define new interaction patterns and experience frameworks that solve emerging customer needs and evolve the design system through practical application in shipped products.

  • Champion modern design and development workflows, including AI-assisted design and design-to-code capabilities, ensuring our design system is prepared for the future of product development.

What you will bring:

  • 8+ years of experience in Product, UX, Visual, or Experience Design, including significant experience designing and evolving enterprise-scale design systems for complex digital products.

  • Demonstrated expertise in design systems architecture, including component libraries, design tokens, variables, interaction patterns, documentation, governance, and scalable contribution models.

  • Exceptional visual and interaction design skills with a portfolio that demonstrates the ability to create elegant, intuitive, and highly polished product experiences while translating them into reusable system assets.

  • Familiarity with emerging AI-assisted design and design-to-code workflows, and a strong interest in shaping how design systems enable the future of product development.

  • Experience designing for desktop, responsive web, and native mobile experiences, with the ability to create scalable patterns that work cohesively across platforms.

  • Deep understanding of how design systems are implemented in code, with experience partnering closely with Engineering to ensure consistency between design and production through shared components, tokens, and front-end technologies.

  • Ability to define and evolve design languages, interaction models, and UX standards that improve product quality, consistency, accessibility, and efficiency across multiple products and teams.

  • Experience establishing new interaction patterns and translating innovations from product work into scalable design system capabilities that can be adopted across an organization.

  • Strong systems thinking and the ability to balance immediate product needs with long-term platform health, maintainability, and scalability.

  • Experience with modern design tooling including Figma component libraries, variables, design tokens, and prototyping, with a passion for improving how designers and engineers work together.

  • Outstanding communication and facilitation skills, with a proven track record of building alignment across Design, Product, and Engineering.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience implementing AI-assisted design and development workflows, including integrating design systems with AI-powered prototyping, design generation, and design-to-code pipelines

  • Familiarity with the gaming, hobby, or collectibles community — particularly trading card games

jobs.description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future

The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region.

This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.

You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology — setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Own

  • Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

  • Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

  • Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

  • Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

  • Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

  • Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

  • Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

  • Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

  • Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

  • Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

  • Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

  • Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

  • Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

  • Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

  • Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

  • Strong ownership mentality — when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.

This Role Is Not For

  • Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

  • Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

  • Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

  • Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

  • People who avoid difficult technical decisions, performance conversations or production issues.

  • Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.

A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.

You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical / engineering leadership interview

  3. CEO / final round

About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.

What You'll Own

  • Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

  • Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

  • Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

  • Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

  • Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

  • Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

  • Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

  • People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

  • Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

  • Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

  • Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

  • People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

  • Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights.

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it.

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Head of Social Media
jobs.excerpt: Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands.
jobs.description:
Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands. Stord is rapidly growing and is on track to double our revenue in the next 18 months. To meet and exceed this target, Stord is strategically scaling teams across the entire company, and seeking energetic experts to help us achieve our mission.

By combining comprehensive commerce-enablement technology with high-volume fulfillment services, Stord provides brands a platform to compete with retail giants. Stord manages over $10 billion of commerce annually through its fulfillment, warehousing, transportation, and operator-built software suite including OMS, Pre- and Post-Purchase, and WMS platforms. Stord is leveling the playing field for all brands to deliver the best consumer experience at scale.

With Stord, brands can increase cart conversion, improve unit economics, and drive sustained customer loyalty. Stord’s end-to-end commerce solutions combine best-in-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order.

Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like AG1, True Classic, Native, Seed Health, quip, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry-leading consumer experiences on every order. Stord is headquartered in Atlanta with facilities across the United States, Canada, and Europe. Stord is backed by top-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Baillie Gifford, and Salesforce Ventures.

Stord is looking for a Head of Social Media to build and run our social presence from the ground up, not just as a strategist overseeing a calendar, but as a hands-on creator who's comfortable being the face and voice behind the content. This role owns three interconnected pillars: CEO and executive social presence, employee advocacy and employee-generated content, and Stord's corporate brand voice across social channels. You'll set the strategy and also execute it, filming, writing, editing, and posting, while building the systems and habits that make social a consistent growth engine for the company.

What You'll Do

  • Own and execute CEO and executive social strategy: ghostwrite and co-create posts, identify moments worth capturing, coach executives on their on-camera and written presence, and turn their expertise into content that builds authority and reach.

  • Build and scale an employee advocacy program that turns Stordians into authentic voices for the brand, sourcing stories, training employees to post confidently, and making it easy for talent across the company to participate.

  • Set corporate social strategy across platforms (LinkedIn, X, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube as relevant) and translate broader marketing and business goals into a channel-specific content plan.

  • Act as an on-camera creator yourself when needed, comfortable being in front of the camera, producing short-form video, and setting the creative bar rather than just directing others toward it.

  • Manage end-to-end execution: content calendars, production workflows, publishing cadence, and performance reporting tied to real business outcomes (pipeline, brand awareness, talent attraction).

  • Partner cross-functionally with Marketing, People/Talent, Sales, and the executive team to source stories, align messaging, and keep social content grounded in what's actually happening at the company.

  • Stay ahead of platform trends and formats, testing new approaches rather than defaulting to what's worked before.

What You'll Bring

  • 6+ years in social media, content, or communications roles, including experience building programs from scratch rather than just maintaining existing ones.

  • A portfolio or track record showing you can both strategize and execute; you can point to content you personally created, not just directed.

  • Experience supporting executive or founder-level social presence (ghostwriting, coaching, or content strategy for leadership).

  • Comfort being on camera and treating yourself as a creator, not only a behind-the-scenes strategist.

  • Strong writing skills and a sharp editorial instinct for what makes content feel authentic versus corporate.

  • Experience in B2B, tech, or a comparably complex industry is a plus. Ability to translate technical or operational subject matter (supply chain, logistics) into engaging, human content is valuable here.

  • A bias toward action: comfortable owning ambiguity and building process rather than waiting for one to be handed to you.

Why This Role Matters at Stord

Social is becoming one of the most trusted channels for B2B buyers and talent alike, and this role is a bet on that shift. You'd be joining at a stage where the strategy and the muscle memory for consistent, high-quality social content are still being built, meaning your fingerprints will be on how Stord shows up in the market for years to come.

jobs.excerpt: The MissionA brilliant game concept and a perfect math model mean nothing if the client-side execution isn't liquid-smooth.
jobs.description:
The Mission

A brilliant game concept and a perfect math model mean nothing if the client-side execution isn't liquid-smooth. We aren’t looking for a standard web developer who just builds static layouts and basic forms. We need a "Kinetic Interface Engineer" to bring our entire iGaming pipeline to life across desktop and mobile browsers. Your job is to take raw visual assets, audio cues, and server-side logic, and fuse them into spectacular, high-performance casino games that run flawlessly at 60 frames per second.

You will step directly into an elite, highly collaborative team environment, working shoulder-to-shoulder with product owners, digital artists, sound designers, backend engineers, and mathematicians. Your focus is the absolute frontier of browser-based gaming: making graphics pop with striking animations, managing relentless game flow, and implementing crisp mechanics that react instantly to our game servers. If you view browser performance as a high-stakes puzzle and have the drive to build the slickest player experiences on the web, your canvas is ready.

Key Responsibilities

  • Client-Side Game Production: Architect, develop, and maintain high-fidelity, cross-browser casino games optimized flawlessly for both desktop and mobile viewports.

  • Visual & Kinetic Engineering: Take static visual assets and breathe immediate life into them utilizing advanced rendering, particle effects, and high-performance animation timelines.

  • Server-Driven Game Flow: Connect client-side interfaces smoothly to our core game servers, orchestrating real-time state changes, payout reveals, and audio-visual synchronization based on incoming server data packets.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner actively as a core technical driver within a cross-disciplinary squad—ensuring game artwork, audio streams, and mathematical logic are unified perfectly in the final build.

  • Performance Tuning & Optimization: Ruthlessly profile memory usage, minimize draw calls, optimize asset loading sheets, and squash layout shifts to guarantee blazing-fast execution across global cellular networks.

  • Codebase Maintenance: Write clean, modular, and self-documenting code layouts, ensuring our game engine patterns remain scalable, predictable, and ready for rapid deployment cycles.

The Frontend Arsenal

You must possess elite, hands-on mastery and deployment speed across the following technical stack:

  • Core Languages: TypeScript and JavaScript (Advanced object-oriented and functional programming patterns).

  • Rendering & Web Graphics: HTML5 and WebGL (Deep understanding of the browser rendering pipeline, canvas manipulation, and GPU-accelerated graphics).

  • Engines & Libraries: PixiJS (or equivalent high-performance 2D WebGL rendering engines) and GSAP (GreenSock Animation Platform for intricate, programmatic timing and animation scripting).

The Requirements

  • The "Interactive Craftsman": Proven experience building rich, highly animated interactive web content, premium digital animations, or browser-based games. You know exactly how to make an interface feel alive and satisfying to touch.

  • Mobile-First Instinct: Deep intuition for cross-browser constraints, touch event handling, responsive scaling logic, and mobile asset optimization limitations.

  • The Collaborative Team Member: Exceptional communication skills and a ego-free approach to working inside a high-speed, multi-disciplinary development loop where code meets art and mathematics.

  • Hyper-Availability: This isn't a passive 9-to-5 desk track. The global gaming ecosystem moves fast, and major feature drops happen continuously. You must be available 7 days a week to handle real-time production hotfixes, launch window validations, and rapid updates.

  • Operational Autonomy: Self-motivated and highly structured; you write clean code, manage your asset pipeline meticulously, and can drive features across the finish line without constant supervision.

Operational Details

  • Location: Fully Remote.

  • Schedule: On-call 7 days a week (Requires high flexibility to align with real-time launch windows, global code releases, and system updates).

  • Payment: All compensation is processed in digital assets (USDC/USDT).

Why Join Us?

We offer more than just a software engineering ticket-shuffling job; we offer the chance to paint the interactive footprint of a global powerhouse.

  • Extreme Technical Autonomy: We value clean execution, performance wins, and innovative code architecture over red tape. If your game framework is fast and flawless, we ship it.

  • Global Stage: Your visual execution, animations, and code loops will instantly face a worldwide audience, commanding the entertainment experience for thousands of active players every single second.

  • A Culture of Pure Momentum: Join an elite squad that moves at lightspeed. You will be constantly building, testing fresh gameplay mechanics, and seeing your engineering hit production in real time.

  • High-Growth Upside: We value "potential over pedigree." For a Game Developer who consistently delivers uncompromised game flow and scales our front-end capacity, there is a clear, unrestricted runway to lead our entire client-side engineering organization.

The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region.

This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.

You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology — setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Own

  • Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

  • Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

  • Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

  • Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

  • Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

  • Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

  • Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

  • Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

  • Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

  • Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

  • Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

  • Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

  • Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

  • Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

  • Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

  • Strong ownership mentality — when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.

This Role Is Not For

  • Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

  • Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

  • Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

  • Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

  • People who avoid difficult technical decisions, performance conversations or production issues.

  • Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.

A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.

You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

Senior AI Interaction Evaluator (Codex / Claude Code)

Contract | $100–$200/hour | 10–20 hrs/week | Start ASAP (through early May)

Check out this Loom video for more details!

We’re looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.

This is not a traditional engineering role.

You won’t be writing production code.

You’ll be evaluating something harder: whether the model thinks like a great engineer.

What This Role Actually Is

You will assess how AI coding agents behave in real-world scenarios — focusing on:

  • Whether the response makes sense

  • Whether the preamble and reasoning are useful

  • Whether the output reflects strong engineering judgment

  • Whether the interaction feels right to an experienced developer

This role is about engineering taste — not syntax correctness.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Evaluate AI-generated coding interactions end-to-end

  • Judge whether outputs are:

    • Useful

    • Correct (at a high level)

    • Aligned with how a strong engineer would think

  • Assess the quality of explanations and reasoning, not just code

  • Distinguish between different levels of response quality (e.g. what makes something a 2 vs 4)

  • Provide clear, opinionated feedback on:

    • What worked

    • What didn’t

    • What felt “off” or misleading

  • Help define what great looks like when interacting with tools like Cursor

What We Mean by “Taste”

We’re specifically looking for engineers who can answer questions like:

  • Does this feel like something a strong engineer would actually say?

  • Is this explanation helpful, or just technically correct?

  • Is the model guiding the user well, or just dumping output?

  • Would this interaction build or erode trust?

You should be comfortable making subjective but rigorous judgments.

Who You Are

  • Staff / Principal-level engineer (or equivalent experience)

  • Strong background in one of the below:

    • TypeScript / JavaScript

    • Python

  • Hands-on experience using:

    • OpenAI Codex

    • Claude Code

    • Cursor

  • Deep familiarity with modern AI-assisted dev workflows

  • Able to evaluate code without needing to fully execute or deeply review every line

  • Comfortable giving direct, opinionated feedback

  • High bar for what “good engineering” looks like

Nice to Have

  • Experience with tools like Cursor or similar AI-first IDEs

  • Prior exposure to prompt design or evaluation workflows

  • Experience mentoring senior engineers or defining engineering standards

Engagement Details

  • Rate: $100–$200/hour

  • Hours: ~10–20 hours/week

  • Duration: Through early May (with possible extension)

  • Start: ASAP

  • Process:

    • Take-home evaluation exercise

    • One behavioral interview

The Mission

A beautifully designed slot machine is completely useless if the underlying math engine doesn't grip the player. We aren't looking for an isolated academic or a passive spreadsheet clerk who just calculates basic probabilities. We need a "Volatility Architect" to design the mathematical heart of our iGaming ecosystem. Your job is to engineer the exact numerical frameworks—the hitting frequencies, cascading bonus loops, and risk profiles—that generate psychological suspense and thrill players with surgical precision. This is a remote, high-availability role for a math mastermind who can transform raw numbers into pure, unadulterated excitement.

We value predictive logic, algorithmic creativity, and a killer product instinct over standard corporate pedigrees. You will step directly into an elite, multi-disciplinary engine room, collaborating closely with slot developers, digital artists, kinetic animators, and product owners to deliver the most thrilling casino games on the market. If you are an exceptional, high-vibe individual with spectacular analytical depth, a passion for data-driven iteration, and the drive to code your models into reality, we will give you the ultimate playground to build your legacy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Math Model Engineering: Design, simulate, and calibrate advanced mathematical models for slots and iGaming titles, balancing RTP (Return to Player) targets with compelling gameplay mechanics.

  • Java Logic Implementation: Write clean, efficient, and robust Java code to build out math engines, game logic components, and high-fidelity simulation frameworks.

  • Full-Spectrum Collaboration: Partner deeply as an integral core team member alongside graphics artists, sound designers, backend devs, and product managers to ensure the math translates perfectly into audio-visual rhythm.

  • Massive Simulation Runs: Execute trillions of simulated game rounds to stress-test your models, ensuring theoretical payout distributions perfectly align with absolute regulatory compliance.

  • Performance Analytics: Dissect live game metrics, revenue models, and player spin telemetry with cold, analytical rigor, using real-world data to sharpen the math for our next breakout title.

  • Documentation & Verification: Author crystal-clear mathematical specification documents and paytables, handling the technical compliance loops required to clear external testing laboratories.

The Requirements

  • The "Math Mastermind": A world-class analytical mind with spectacular mastery of probability theory, combinatorics, and statistical modeling. You look at numbers and see human behavior.

  • Java Mastery: Robust, hands-on experience writing and deploying clean code in Java. You don't just calculate theoretical models on paper; you possess the technical skill to build your own simulation environments.

  • The Gamer's Intuition: A profound, innate understanding of what makes an iGaming title exciting, volatile, and deeply retentive. You know exactly how a near-miss or a staggered bonus multiplier feels to a player.

  • Hyper-Availability: This isn't a slow-moving academic office. The global iGaming market operates 24/7/365, and production loops move fast. You must be available 7 days a week to handle real-time simulation pivots, launch validations, and urgent math revisions.

  • Operational Autonomy: A great teammate who brings infectious energy, zero ego, and a relentless focus on execution. You can manage complex statistical projects from your laptop without any hand-holding.

Operational Details

  • Location: Fully Remote.

  • Schedule: On-call 7 days a week (Requires high flexibility to align with real-time launch windows, data sprints, and global engineering timelines).

  • Payment: All compensation is processed in digital assets (USDC/USDT).

Why Join Us?

We offer more than just a data-science desk; we offer the chance to anchor the revenue engine of an aggressive global powerhouse.

  • Absolute Strategic Sovereignty: We value raw output and technical innovation over corporate red tape. If your math models pass simulations and drive player retention, we push them live.

  • Global Infrastructure: Your code and logic will instantly step onto a worldwide stage, driving the core entertainment loops for thousands of active players every single second.

  • A Culture of Pure Momentum: Join an elite squad that moves at lightspeed. You will be constantly building, testing fresh payout paradigms, and seeing your technical execution hit production in real time.

  • High-Growth Upside: We value "potential over pedigree." For a Game Mathematician who consistently engineers highly commercial, top-tier math engines, there is a clear, unrestricted runway to lead our entire gaming architecture and analytics ecosystem.

  4. Infer and accurately annotate partially occluded or visually challenging joints and landmarks, reasoning through complex hand positions and object interactions.
  5. Interpret a wide range of hand poses, orientations, and perspectives to ensure consistent and high-quality annotations across varied image and video data.
  6. Review visual feedback, identify deviations from requirements, and make targeted corrections to maintain annotation quality at scale.

About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.

What You'll Own

  • Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

  • Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

  • Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

  • Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

  • Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

  • Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

  • Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

  • People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

  • Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

  • Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

  • Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

  • People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

  • Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights.

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it.

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Thanks for your interest in Oklo! We are searching for a Process Engineer to join our Fuel Recycling engineering team.

Position Description

The person in this role is responsible for conducting design, development, prototyping, and validation work on key chemical separation subsystems and supporting systems for Oklo’s fuel recycling facility. These subsystems may include pyroprocessing, off-gas separation, and waste immobilization. It will include collaboration with cross-functional teams including those with a focus on facility design, unit process equipment design, and licensing.

Specific responsibilities may include:

  • Developing systems that meet facility and regulatory requirements

  • Defining system and unit process requirements and validation methodologies

  • Establishing performance criteria, test protocols, and prototyping equipment

  • Developing technical parameters and deploying and operating test systems to use in refining system design and operation

  • Completing equipment sizing and specifications and developing instrument process data specifications

  • Developing process flow sheets and heat and material balances using process simulation tools

  • Developing and maintaining process and instrumentation diagrams

  • Generating documentation to guide the fabrication, installation, commissioning, operation, and maintenance of subsystems

  • Serving as a technical lead through multiple lifecycle stages

  • Generating technical documentation to be included in regulatory filings

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Degree in chemical engineering or related field

  • 7+ years of experience in chemical engineering or related field

Bonus Qualifications:

  • Experience using AspenTech, ChemCAD, Promax, automation, Excel, Python, etc., for process and equipment design, reliability studies, and economic analysis

  • Experience deploying or working on pilot plants and scaling from demonstration to industrial scale at brown/green field sites

  • Commercial or government nuclear industry experiences

Competencies

We are looking for a Process Engineer that is

  • Passionate about clean energy

  • An optimist at heart

  • Passionate about making advanced fission a reality

  • Willing and able to learn quickly

  • Willing to think differently and do things in new ways

  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, highly iterative startup environment

  • Excited to think creatively, critically, and reflectively about the problems they are solving while not leaning only on what has been done before

  • Willing to propose novel and creative solutions to technical problems

  • An excellent writer who can write in a modern active voice, so make your cover letter compelling and write it well!

  • Able to communicate technical content and results verbally

Who you are:

A startup person: You aren't driven by titles or hierarchy, and prefer efficiency to excess process. You don't need or expect to have a lot of guidance but you enjoy working in a fast-paced team. If you prefer the culture and feel of a large organization, that is great, but you likely won’t enjoy working with us! There is plenty of important work and plenty of good opportunities with organizations like that.

Motivated: You are self-motivated. You bring an enthusiasm to the team, and imbue a sense of passion that goes beyond clocking in and clocking out. This isn’t about a fake or arbitrary “pieces of flair” mentality or lack of work-life balance! It is about being a part of the vision and feeling a part of reaching team goals.

A team-player: Oklo genuinely is a team. We aren’t about taking credit for ourselves, and we aren’t about pushing blame to others. We do incredible things because we work as a team.

An excellent communicator: We need a person who is not only technically competent but also a clear and upbeat communicator.

Creative: Being creative means that when things fall outside clear scopes or processes or problems arise without clear solutions, you are able to identify it as well as invent ways to solve a problem or fill a need without micromanagement. The successful person in this job will not only be creative, but also enjoy being creative and solving open-ended problems which may change day-by-day.

Detail-oriented: This focus is a big part of excellence, consistency, and quality. Excellent grammar and spelling matter for both good communication as well as the image of the company that we put forward.

About Oklo travel requirements:

Oklo requires remote employees to travel to headquarters (Santa Clara, CA) twice a quarter annually, based on business or team needs, including attendance at team meetings, off-sites, and other company events or gatherings. For the first two weeks of onboarding, employees are required to be in person at headquarters in Santa Clara, CA.

About Oklo compensation:

Salary: $100,000-$160,000

Oklo offers flexible time off, equity, competitive pay, 401k, health insurance, FSA, flexible work hours, and other benefits.

This position may involve access to information subject to U.S. export control laws. Only applicants who meet the definition of a U.S. person under applicable laws may be eligible.

About Oklo Inc.: Oklo Inc. is developing fast fission power plants to deliver clean, reliable, and affordable energy at scale; establishing a domestic supply chain for critical radioisotopes; and advancing nuclear fuel recycling to convert nuclear waste into clean energy. Oklo was the first to receive a site use permit from the U.S. Department of Energy for a commercial advanced fission plant, was awarded fuel material from Idaho National Laboratory, and submitted the first custom combined license application for an advanced reactor to the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission. Oklo is also developing advanced fuel recycling technologies in collaboration with the U.S. Department of Energy and U.S. National Laboratories.

#CHOP: Oklo’s Values
Collaboration: We go further, together. We bring diverse perspectives, listen actively, and build trust through transparency and respect. We work across disciplines, sharing ownership to turn complex challenges into shared successes.
Humility: We are team players who act for the good of the company and for the world. We are focused on our mission, not personal recognition.

Pathfinding: We chart new ground where no path exists by approaching challenges with curiosity, courage, and creativity while navigating ambiguity.
